set_aside.subject: command-line argument-count start check
set_aside.text: State 4 assigns “its command line holding exactly one argument or the start stopping” to `capability:surface.serve_kernel` and names `module:surface` for that failure, while State 3 says `module:installation` “Owns A17: the configuration file and its start checks,” and A17 rule 1 includes refusal when there are none or more than one command-line arguments.
set_aside.question: Does `module:surface` own and perform the exactly-one-command-line-argument check, or does `module:installation` own it as an A17 installation start check?
options: `module:surface` checks argument count and passes the sole path to `installation.load_installation`
`module:installation.load_installation` receives the command line and checks its argument count
set_aside.default_guess: Follow the changed State 4 flow: `module:surface` checks the argument count and passes the sole argument to `module:installation`.
